edits.current:
? "

A host callback with checked Lean Fin, Subtype or checked-record semantics must be passed through with_recovery(callback, value). The recovery has the callback's exact erased result type, a generated value record carrying only payload fields for a checked record, and is validated before Lean or the callback runs. Lean checks every host-produced Fin bound and applies the selected checked constructor to every Subtype leaf and checked record, nested checked fields before their record. Bound or constructor rejection, a thrown exception or another callback failure fails the enclosing call, suppresses later callbacks and leaves its output unchanged; the recovery is used only inside Lean's failure path and is never returned as a successful result. Fin, Subtype and checked-record arguments to returned LeanClosure values are checked before the closure body runs; checked records Lean produces for the host carry payload fields only."
		: "

Each callback declaration exposes a PREFIX_CALLBACK_REQUIRES_RECOVERY macro. When it is 1, initialize the descriptor's typed recovery pointer before calling Lean and keep that value alive for the call; for a checked record it points at an initialized generated record carrying only payload fields. The adapter validates and copies it before Lean or the callback runs. Lean checks every host-produced Fin bound and applies the selected checked constructor to every Subtype leaf and checked record, nested checked fields before their record. Bound or constructor rejection, a non-OK callback status or another callback failure fails the enclosing call, suppresses later callbacks and leaves its output unchanged; the recovery is used only inside Lean's failure path and is never written as successful output. Fin, Subtype and checked-record arguments to returned Lean closures are checked before the closure body runs; checked records Lean produces for the host carry payload fields only.";
